title: No escript entrypoint — factual/runtime probes could not launch the server
evidence: _factual.json & _runtime.json both: ok=false, note "mix.exs declares no escript entrypoint"; mix.exs:1-13 defines no :escript key. Server is instead launched via `mix mcp` (lib/mix/tasks/mcp.ex:4).
suggestion: Add `escript: [main_module: ...]` or a documented stdio entrypoint the retort factual/runtime probe can invoke, so factual_accuracy/runtime are measurable; functionally the MCP server is reachable via `mix mcp`.
